scope: same completed-bed physical weak transport, consistent nodal content and prescribed actual nodal velocities; bounded moving content stages, not a solved-momentum ocean factory
assembly: reuse the registered physical-face quadrature; assemble column diagonal/adjacent bands and both-column hat overlap blocks; a fixed graph includes adjacent same-column wet nodes and every potential wet-node pair across each physical column face, permitting changing vertical overlap; no global dense Jacobian or old same-index stencil
topology: periodic east, closed north, nx>=3 avoids duplicate unordered east pairs; binary contiguous wet mask, finite positive metric arrays; deterministic degree-group gather reductions, disjoint writes; explicit column-by-nz-squared overlap workspace, actual-grid memory not assumed qualified
capacity_revision: first full360x132x14 CUDA prescribed stage failed allocating2.18GiB; retain it and its source. Coefficients now stream16 original longitude columns plus one actual periodic east halo with lax.scan, preserving all latitude columns and exact original closed north wall; crop only redundant halo/padding outputs, never physical wet nodes. Check wrap and incomplete last block against unchanged independent quadrature/Jacobian, rerun same full grid/source/duration/dtype
identities: small controls independently verify sparse B against NumPy five-point weak quadrature and a global Jacobian oracle used only for small tests; 1^T B=0 and B1=dot(m); actual mass M and row mass m at both geometries, no residual compensation
low_stage: symmetric zero-row/column-sum graph viscosity d_ij=max(0,-B_ij,-B_ji) makes off-diagonal B+D nonnegative; low row-content at actual endpoint mass, same declared source content S in both paths; duration*sum(offdiag(B+D))/m_new<=0.5, low state and geometry explicitly checked
high_stage: M_new*c_H=M_old*c_old+duration*B*c_old+S; antisymmetric correction f_ij=M_new,ij*(c_H,i-c_H,j)-M_old,ij*(c_old,i-c_old,j)+duration*d_ij*(c_old,i-c_old,j); verify high-low row-content decomposition at64eps of actual absolute operations, no subtraction of a remaining residual
limiter: pairwise shared flux factors from low-state allowances relative to old physical graph neighbor concentration bounds shifted by S/m_new; encode corrected row-content back into actual consistent nodal content, not retain a different lumped representation; compare actual decoded node bounds and total inventory, separately report limited-minus-high potential change
sources: finite explicit wet nodal content amount derived from prescribed content rate and duration; source accounting uses sum(S), independently report physical heat with rho0*cp when thermal controls are used; dry source nonzero is refused, no constant-volume shortcut or relabeling limiter transfer as heating
rollback: refuse nonfinite active inputs, invalid or nonpositive geometry, source, incompatible mass/graph, identity/decomposition failures or stage CFL; original surface/content and inactive bytes returned on refusal, no clipping
qualification: constant field, nonnegative pulse, signed random, finite/NaN dry sentinels, wet heat source, zero-flow high-order identity, independent sparse rates/mass/low/correction/source inventory and actual bounds; frozen CPU then actual CUDA; preserve unlimited high-order overshoot as a negative control; SSP stage combination does not alone prove temporal order
oracle_scale_revision: first near-zero pulse stock comparison failed when only local near-zero stock scaled the floor, despite passing unchanged actual nodal bounds; archive first failure and diagnostic. Independent solver comparison now includes64eps*endpoint_row_mass*(1+max absolute initial tracer), reflecting absolute point-field precision in decoded zero tails; independently check dense old-mass solve backward residual too. This does not alter kernel bounds, inventory/identity gates, pressure gates or pulse negativity threshold, and is not a change of model solution
thermal_transfer: convert limited-minus-high thermal content to linear-Boussinesq density content with -rho0*alpha_T before evaluating potential difference; record either sign as numerical transfer, not assume entropy/energy dissipation or an external heat source
not_qualified: complete diffusion/source suite, limiter entropy/complete mechanical energy, arbitrary moving-mass momentum, actual barotropic mean matching, complete-step PDE order or gradients, restart/factory promotion, actual1degree integration, century/climate/forecast or industrial ranking
